subject.title: WhatsApp pairing can stick at Logging in until gateway restart finalizes 515 recovery

question: Should this 515/manual-restart finalization gap be resolved inside the active WhatsApp phone-code login work, or tracked as a separate WhatsApp auth-readiness/recovery fix after that API decision settles?
rationale: The remaining work overlaps public channel login API design, Baileys phone-code behavior, and persisted WhatsApp credential readiness; automation cannot safely choose that product/API boundary from source inspection alone.

options.title: Tie It To Phone-Code Landing
options.body: Require the active phone-code PR path to prove that pairing reaches linked healthy status without an operator gateway restart, including stale partial-credential cleanup and live WhatsApp proof.

options.title: Split A Recovery Fix
options.body: Keep phone-code entrypoint review separate and open a narrower WhatsApp-owned recovery issue for 515 finalization and incomplete persisted auth state.

options.title: Document As Operator Workaround
options.body: Accept the gateway restart as the supported recovery path for this edge case and update troubleshooting docs instead of changing runtime behavior now.

recommendation.title: Tie It To Phone-Code Landing
recommendation.body: Require the active phone-code PR path to prove that pairing reaches linked healthy status without an operator gateway restart, including stale partial-credential cleanup and live WhatsApp proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses public CLI, plugin SDK/channel auth, and WhatsApp plugin ownership boundaries where history points to steipete as the best routing owner.
